title: A Good Boy and a Very Good Girl

lessons.title: Two familiar nouns, now with their gender
lessons.gloss: boy is masculine; girl is feminine

segments.text: From the last chapter, say ਕਿਤਾਬ ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ once. Now say the two familiar people words: ਮੁੰਡਾ (muṇḍā, boy), then ਕੁੜੀ (kuṛī, girl). Nothing about their meaning or spelling is new.

blocks.title: Grammar Lens: masculine and feminine nouns

segments.text: Punjabi nouns have grammatical gender. For this first bounded pair:

utterances: noun: ਮੁੰਡਾ — muṇḍā. meaning: boy. gender: masculine.
noun: ਕੁੜੀ — kuṛī. meaning: girl. gender: feminine.

segments.text: The endings help with this pair, but do not turn them into a universal guessing rule. Punjabi has masculine and feminine nouns whose endings do not advertise their gender. Learn the gender with the noun.

segments.instruction: ਮੁੰਡਾ, ਕੁੜੀ; YOU NAME: masculine, feminine
segments.source: [YOU READ: **ਮੁੰਡਾ · ਕੁੜੀ**; YOU NAME: masculine · feminine]

segments.text: Which familiar noun is masculine? (ਮੁੰਡਾ.) Which is feminine? (ਕੁੜੀ.) Keep the claim to this pair for now.
Source: University of Waterloo, PUN 1100 Course Package (2018), pp. 54–55, Nouns and Gender.

lessons.title: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) — put the quality before the noun
lessons.gloss: good boy - adjective immediately before its noun

segments.text: First retrieve the last chapter's location frame once: ਕਿਤਾਬ ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੈ. Then retrieve ਚੰਗਾ (changā, good) and ਮੁੰਡਾ (muṇḍā, boy). Name ਮੁੰਡਾ as masculine. Keep the last two words separate for one breath.
Join them in this order:
ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) — changā muṇḍā — good boy.

In this noun phrase, ਚੰਗਾ describes ਮੁੰਡਾ and sits immediately before it: adjective first, noun second. This lesson owns that attributive pattern. It does not claim that an adjective can never appear after a noun in another kind of Punjabi sentence.

segments.instruction: adjective ਚੰਗਾ first; noun ਮੁੰਡਾ second

segments.text: Say good boy. (ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda).) Which word comes immediately before the noun? (ਚੰਗਾ, the adjective.)
Source: Columbia University Punjabi Language Resource Center, Simple Sentence Structure.

lessons.title: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda), ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ — let the adjective agree
lessons.gloss: good boy, good girl - one adjective agrees with two singular nouns

segments.text: Say ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda). Then retrieve the familiar feminine noun ਕੁੜੀ. Keep the adjective before the noun in both phrases.

blocks.title: Grammar Lens: change the adjective ending

segments.text: ਚੰਗਾ is a variable adjective. In this singular direct contrast, its ending agrees with the noun's gender:

utterances: noun gender: masculine. adjective + noun: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) — changā muṇḍā. meaning: good boy.
noun gender: feminine. adjective + noun: ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ — changī kuṛī. meaning: good girl.

segments.text: The noun changes from ਮੁੰਡਾ to ਕੁੜੀ; the adjective changes from ਚੰਗਾ to ਚੰਗੀ. This is one bounded singular direct contrast, not the whole Punjabi adjective system. Plural and oblique forms wait.

segments.instruction: ਮੁੰਡਾ; YOU BUILD: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda)
ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) becomes ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ

segments.text: Say the masculine phrase, then the feminine phrase. Which piece changes to agree? (ਚੰਗਾ / ਚੰਗੀ, the adjective.)
Sources: University of Waterloo, PUN 1100 Course Package (2018), pp. 71–74, Adjectives; Columbia University Punjabi Language Resource Center, Simple Sentence Structure.

lessons.title: ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) — turn good into very good
lessons.gloss: very - placed before an adjective to increase its degree

segments.text: Say ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda), then ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ. Hear the one ending that changes and the adjective-before-noun order that stays.
ਬਹੁਤ — bahut — very.
Put ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) before the adjective. It increases the degree; it does not take the adjective's agreement ending:
ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) — bahut changā muṇḍā — very good boy ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ — bahut changī kuṛī — very good girl.
The order is degree word + agreeing adjective + noun. Only ਚੰਗਾ / ਚੰਗੀ changes with this noun pair; ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) stays ਬਹੁਤ (bahut).

segments.instruction: ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda) becomes ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗਾ ਮੁੰਡਾ (changa munda)
ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ becomes ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ
ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) first; agreeing adjective second; noun last
segments.source: [YOU CHECK: **ਬਹੁਤ** first; agreeing adjective second; noun last]

segments.text: Make ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ stronger. (ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ.) Which word adds very? (ਬਹੁਤ (bahut).) Which word still agrees? (ਚੰਗੀ.)
Source: University of Waterloo, PUN 1100 Course Package (2018), pp. 72–74, Adjective position and degree examples.

lessons.title: One phrase before the verb
lessons.gloss: this is a very good girl - retrieve a multiword noun phrase before hai

needs: your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture
notice.text: Before we start: this one needs your eyes, so it is not fully a driving lesson. You will want your eyes or your hands for the steps that ask you to read, point, write or gesture. You can listen to everything else now. I will say so again when we reach it, but leave this section until you have stopped: Guided Practice.

segments.text: Build ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ one piece at a time. Bring back ਇਹ for this and ਹੈ for is. Keep ਹੈ waiting for the end.

blocks.title: Grammar Lens: the words work as one noun phrase

segments.text: ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ (eh bahut changi kuri hai)। eh bahut changī kuṛī hai. This is a very good girl.

Before ਹੈ, the words ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ travel together as a multiword noun phrase: degree word + agreeing adjective + noun. The noun is feminine, so the variable adjective is ਚੰਗੀ. The verb remains last.
This proves only this one bounded singular direct pattern. It does not add noun plural, genitive, an article, or a rule for every Punjabi adjective.

segments.instruction: eh bahut changī kuṛī hai; YOU POINT: ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ (eh bahut changi kuri hai)
segments.source: [YOU HEAR: *eh bahut changī kuṛī hai*; YOU POINT: **ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ**]

segments.instruction: ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ (eh bahut changi kuri hai)
ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ (eh bahut changi kuri hai)
ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ (eh bahut changi kuri hai) after covering the model
segments.source: [YOU WRITE: **ਇਹ ਬਹੁਤ ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ ਹੈ** after covering the model]

segments.instruction: ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) + ਚੰਗੀ + ਕੁੜੀ all come before ਹੈ

segments.text: Rebuild the sentence from this, very, good, girl, is. Name the multiword noun phrase before the verb. (ਬਹੁਤ (bahut) ਚੰਗੀ ਕੁੜੀ.)
This closes five named points in a partial project-defined inventory. It is not an A1 mock, not A1 readiness or attainment, and not external or human validation.
Sources: University of Waterloo, PUN 1100 Course Package (2018), pp. 54–55, 71–74, Nouns and adjectives; Columbia University Punjabi Language Resource Center, Simple Sentence Structure.
